data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), after one of your **THOUSAND SONS PSYKER** models is **destroyed**.

**Target:** A **RUBRICAE** unit of yours that was up to 6" from that **PSYKER** model at the moment it was destroyed.

**Effect:** Once the enemy unit is done shooting, the **RUBRICAE** unit gets to shoot as though in [your own Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), but only at the enemy unit that destroyed the **PSYKER** model, and only while that unit is an eligible target.
